founded: 1966 (Radhakrishna Group founded); cold chain, QSR service, and food retail operations started 1986
hq: India (multi-city operations; expanded to the Middle East in 2021)
industry: Cold chain warehousing and food distribution logistics -- serving QSRs, cafes, hotels, cloud kitchens, retail, FMCG, and food service
size: 3,000+ trained employees; 2M+ sq ft of warehousing across 30+ distribution centers; 600+ multi-temperature transport assets

facts.claim: The Radhakrishna Group was founded in 1966, with the company's modern cold chain, QSR service, and food retail operations beginning in 1986 -- giving it 38+ years of cold chain industry experience.
facts.source_snippet: Foundation of the group [1966]... Started cold chain, QSR service and Food Retail Operations [1986]... 38+ years of industry experience.

facts.claim: The company operates 2 million+ square feet of warehousing space across 30+ distribution centers in India, reaching over 300 cities and 5,000+ drop points/restaurants, staffed by 3,000+ trained employees.
facts.source_snippet: 300+ cities with 5,000+ restaurants served... 2M square feet across 30+ distribution centers... 3,000+ trained employees.

facts.claim: Radhakrishna Foodland runs 600+ multi-temperature transport assets and reports a 99% on-time delivery performance rate.
facts.source_snippet: 600+ multi-temperature transport assets... 99% on-time performance rate.

facts.claim: Warehousing covers frozen, chilled, tropical, and ambient storage, and the operation is BRCGS certified and FSSAI compliant for food safety.
facts.source_snippet: frozen, chilled, tropical, and ambient storage... BRCGS certified... FSSAI compliant operations... storage and inventory management solutions specifically designed for food and near-food products.

facts.claim: The company describes using 'advanced inventory management technologies' for real-time visibility and control, claiming 99.8%+ inventory accuracy, though it does not name a specific IoT or monitoring platform.
facts.source_snippet: advanced inventory management technologies... real-time visibility and control... 99.8%+ [inventory accuracy].

facts.claim: In 2024 the company introduced its own 'Foodland Operating System' and a supply-chain 'control tower' for data-driven visibility, having expanded operations into the Middle East in 2021.
facts.source_snippet: Foodland Operating System and various digital solutions [2024]... control tower [for] supply chain visibility... data-driven strategies... Expanded footprint overseas, started operations in the Middle East [2021].
